en-US: Android updates now download in the background and are ready to install with fewer interruptions, with the published APK verified against the Google Play app-signing certificate.
The sidebar download menu now offers clearer platform and APK channel choices while keeping note search available in compact layouts.
Sharing styled text into the Android app now preserves the received content more reliably.
zh-CN: Android 更新现在会在后台预下载并准备安装，减少操作打断；正式 APK 同时会核验 Google Play 应用签名证书。
侧边栏下载菜单现在提供更清晰的平台与 APK 渠道选项，并在紧凑布局中保留笔记搜索入口。
向 Android 应用分享带样式文本时，现在能更可靠地保留接收到的内容。
